title: UK Government Considers Banning Under-16s from Vinted and eBay
excerpt: The culture secretary confirms that online marketplaces like Vinted and eBay could face age restrictions next March.
body_html:
The UK government is seriously examining the possibility of prohibiting individuals under the age of sixteen from using popular online marketplaces such as Vinted and eBay.

The country's culture secretary has confirmed recent reports indicating that these platforms might be included in an upcoming list of services facing age-based bans. The potential restrictions are currently under evaluation, with a prospective implementation timeline pointing toward next March.

As discussions continue, officials are reviewing how these marketplace platforms fit into broader safety and regulatory frameworks concerning young users. Further details regarding the scope of the potential bans and the specific platforms involved are expected as the review progresses toward the targeted date.
